shavian_lang_code.description: The BCP 47 language tag to match for Shavian script support.

generic_font_family.description: The generic font family to substitute or prepend when Shavian glyphs are requested in the generic family.

font_family_name.description: The specific font family name provided by the package to use for Shavian script.

font_hinting_enabled.description: Whether to enable font hinting for this specific font match.
